Re: USAID-YouTube Call on "Creative Cohorts" Concept
[opaque block] [contact omitted] Josh Blumenfeld Tuesday, August 2, 2022 at 8:23:04 AM Eastern Daylight Time
To: [contact omitted] Amy Malessa
Cc: [contact omitted] Benjamin Long, [contact omitted] Shadrach Ludeman, [contact omitted] Vera Zakem
Fantastic, thank you

Amy

On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 3:32 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Yes sorry for the typo. Both 4th and 8th at 9am? Yes we have conflicts on the other times unfortunately.
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 3:25 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,
Do you mean August 4th or 8th at 9am EST? I believe we had conflicts on our calendars for those dates/times, but
let me double-check. Are the other options out? If so, I can get back to you with more options from our side.
Thanks again!
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
Senior Digital Technology Advisor for Field Programs Division
Bureau for Conflict Prevention and Stabilization | Office of Transition Initiatives | Creative Digital Team

Mobile: [opaque block] [contact omitted]
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 2:51 PM Josh Blumenfeld < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Amy, no worries at all. Any chance you could do the 4th 8th at 9am EST?
On Mon, Aug 1, 2022 at 12:31 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Quick update on our side: the August 4th option no longer works. Let me know if you need more dates/times!
Happy to go back to our calendars. (:
Best,
Amy

On Mon, Aug 1,2022 at 12:16 PM Amy Malessa <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Josh,

Thanks for your email this morning! I'd like to connect you directly to our Country Representatives for
Ukraine and Moldova, Shadrach Ludeman and Ben Long (in copy here).
Do any of the following dates/times work for you? They are listed below in DC / Eastern Time.
• August 4th at 8am
• August 9th at 8am
• August 11th at 9am
Let's plan to cover introductions, then have you walk us through the "Creative Cohorts" concept and we can
dig into Q&A.
Looking forward to it,
Amy
Amy Noreuil Malessa
